record.excerpt: This strategy was designed for BTCUSD in 4H timeframe … Backtesting context: 2020-01-02 to 2023-01-05 (The strategy has also worked in previous years) … Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position. … The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss … The first profit will be of 0.75 risk/reward ratio where half position will be closed. … When this happens, you move the stop loss to break even. … Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
record.performance_claim: The strategy has also worked in previous years
record.notes: Supertrend flip on BTC 4h with 0.75R partial and breakeven stop; Supertrend/ATR periods not stated (compiler must default). Long side only used for spot.

spec.claim_summary: Enter long when Supertrend flips from downtrend to uptrend with an ATR-based stop, exiting on Supertrend flip to downtrend.
assumptions: BTCUSD mapped to BTCUSDT spot for testing.
Timeframe is 4H as stated in the claim.
Supertrend settings not stated; assumed standard ATR length 10 and multiplier 3 for both entry and exit.
ATR stop-loss multiple and ATR length not stated; assumed 2.0 x 14-period ATR at the signal bar.
Supertrend flip modeled as close crosses_above / crosses_below Supertrend on bar close.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: closing only half position at 0.75 risk/reward while holding the remainder to the opposite Supertrend flip cannot be expressed; modeled as holding the full position to the opposite Supertrend flip with no 0.75R exit.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving stop loss to break even after the 0.75R partial profit cannot be expressed; stop remains at the initial ATR stop.
Backtest window 2020-01-02 to 2023-01-05 recorded in claimed, not as part of the rule.
